title: साहचर्यात्मक अर्थविश्लेषण पद्धति
nepali: साहचर्यात्मक अर्थविश्लेषण पद्धति संरचनावादी भाषावैज्ञानिक फर्थबाट सुरू भई सिङ्क्लेयरले विस्तृत व्याख्या विश्लेषण गरेको अवधारणा हो । शब्दको अर्थसँग सोझो सम्बन्ध हुँदैन । भाषाका कतिपय शब्दहरू सामान्य रूपबाट हेर्दा उस्तै देखिन्छन्, शब्दगत साहचर्यात्मकता देखिन्छ र प्रयोगका सन्दर्भमा पनि पर्यायवाची शब्दका रूपमा प्रयोग गर्न सकिने लाग्दछ तर तिनीहरू एउटा शब्दसँग जसरी आउन सक्छन् अर्काे शब्दसँग त्यही रूपमा आउन सक्दैनन् । यी शब्दका बिच साहचर्यात्मक सम्बन्ध हुन्छ । यस किसिमको साहचर्यात्मक अर्थ विश्लेषणका लागि वितरणात्मक र संज्ञानात्मक दुई किसिमका पद्धति प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । सहचर शब्दको वितरणका आधारमा अर्थ विश्लेषण गर्ने पद्धति वितरणात्मक पद्धति हो । यसमा वाक्यमा प्रयुक्त पदहरूको वितरणलाई हेरेर त्यसका आधारमा ती पद र पदावलीको अर्थ विश्लेषण गरिन्छ । संज्ञानात्मक पद्धतिमा शाब्दिक अर्थ जोडेर अर्थको विश्लेषण नगरी त्यसमा व्यक्त भएको तात्पर्य अर्थ हेरिन्छ । यो मानिसको बोध क्षमता र अनुभवमा आधारित हुन्छ ।
american_english: Collocational semantic analysis is a concept that originated with the structuralist linguist Firth and was explained and analyzed in detail by Sinclair. A word does not have a direct relationship with its meaning. Some words of a language, when viewed in an ordinary way, appear similar, word-level collocationality is seen, and in the context of use they also seem to be usable as synonymous words, but just as they can occur with one word, they cannot occur in that same form with another word. There is a collocational relationship between these words. For this kind of collocational semantic analysis, two kinds of methods — distributive and cognitive — have been presented. The method of analyzing meaning on the basis of the distribution of collocating words is the distributive method. In this, the meaning of those words and phrases is analyzed by looking at the distribution of the words used in the sentence. In the cognitive method, rather than analyzing meaning by adding lexical meaning, the implied meaning expressed in it is examined. This is based on human cognitive ability and experience.

informal_english: So collocational semantic analysis is a concept that started off with the structuralist linguist Firth and was teased out in detail by Sinclair. A word hasn't got a direct relationship with its meaning. Some words in a language look much the same at first glance, you can see word-level collocationality, and in use they even seem like they could be used as synonyms, but while they can turn up with one word, they can't turn up in that same shape with another. There's a collocational relationship between these words. For this sort of collocational semantic analysis, two kinds of methods are put forward — distributive and cognitive. The distributive method is the one that analyses meaning on the basis of how collocating words are distributed. In it, the meaning of those words and phrases is analysed by looking at how the words in the sentence are distributed. In the cognitive method, instead of analysing meaning by piling on lexical meaning, you look at the implied meaning that comes through. This is grounded in people's capacity to understand and in their experience.
